newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Bezeq Telecom rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bezeq Telecom rated buy.

text.p: Sahar Securities Ltd, an Israeli brokerage, has rated Bezeq Israel Telecom a buy, despite the fact that its key international-calling business is being opened up to competition.

Analyst Boaz Levitan set a target price for Bezeq shares traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange at 9.5-10.5 shekels based on a decline in 1997 projected earnings per share to 0.75 shekel from a forecast 0.85 shekel this year.
Bezeq closed on Tuesday at 8.13 shekel.

"In our opinion the damage entailed in the opening of the international-calling market will be less than the market expects, the impact of the a third cellular telephone operator will be insignificant and most important of all management will exploit the company's relative size and wealth to defend its traditional markets and to break into new ones," said Levitan.
He said that although Bezeq managing director Yitzhak Kaul was due to leave the company soon, he was leaving behind a strong management team.
Sahar said it expected Bezeq earnings to recover in 1998 to 0.89 shekel per share.
